summary: Pangram Pangram × Locomotive microsite for a four-cut family (Sans, Glare, Serif, Text), black and monochrome. 3D renders of glass letter shards float and rotate as you scroll, and letters 'roll' through the four cuts like a slot machine. Three Randomize buttons do the specimen work: re-styling a sentence across cuts, shuffling posters over architecture photos, and so on. The rest is a standard sequence: glyph set, sampler, language list, then buy / try / wallpaper cards.

instances.ux: Long black loader (~8s, small spinner) before the hero; each letter rolls vertically through the four cuts at its own speed (1.3–2.3s); shards drift; fixed top bar with 'GET THE FONT'; 'Table of Contents' tab on the left edge
instances.learn: Let every letter of the name cycle through the cuts at a different speed: the wordmark itself shows that the four styles share one skeleton
